name: HoverCard
description: A compound component built on @radix-ui/react-hover-card that displays rich content in a floating card when the user hovers over a trigger element. Includes animated enter/exit transitions.

props.name: HoverCard (Root)
props.description: Wrapper component. Accepts openDelay, closeDelay, open, onOpenChange, and defaultOpen from Radix HoverCard.Root.

props.name: HoverCardTrigger
props.description: The element that triggers the hover card on hover. Renders as a child element.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes merged via cn() onto HoverCardContent.

props.name: align
props.description: The preferred alignment of the content relative to the trigger.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Distance in pixels between the content and the trigger.

accessibility.keyboard: Content is shown on hover; Radix manages focus and dismissal.
accessibility.aria: Radix primitives handle aria attributes automatically for hover card semantics.
accessibility.notes: The content panel includes animated transitions (fade and zoom) and supports directional slide-in based on the side placement.
